3,\n47\t  \"id\": \"uuid-v4\",\n48\t  \"timestamp\": \"2024-12-03T14:00:00.000Z\",\n49\t  \"cwd\": \"/path/to/project\"\n50\t}\n51\t```\n52\t\n53\tFor sessions with a parent (created via `/fork`, entries (except session header) share this base structure:\n69\t\n70\t```json\n71\t{\n72\t  \"type\": \"entry-type\",\n73\t  \"id\": \"8-char-hex\",\n74\t  \"parentId\": \"parent-id-or-null\",\n75\t  \"timestamp\": \"ISO-8601-string\"\n76\t}\n77\t```\n78\t\n79\t- `id`: 8-character hex string (collision-checked)\n80\t- `parentId`: ID of parent entry, or `null` for first entry\n81\t- `timestamp`: ISO-8601 format string (e.g., \"2024-12-03T14:00:01.000Z\")\n82\t\n83\t### Entry Types\n84\t\n85\t| Type | Description | Handling |\n86\t|------|-------------|----------|\n87\t| `message` |
